articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated in accordance with the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China, the Agriculture Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws, for the purposes of regulating agricultural insurance activities, protecting the lawful rights and interests of the parties involved in agricultural insurance activities, improving the capacity of agricultural production to resist risks, and promoting the healthy development of the agricultural insurance industry.

Article 2 For the purposes of these Regulations, 'agricultural insurance' refers to the insurance activities in which an insurance institution, in accordance with an agricultural insurance contract, assumes the liability to pay insurance compensation for the property losses of the insured arising from such insurance accidents as agreed natural disasters, accidents, epidemics, diseases, etc. suffered by the subject matter insured in the production of crop farming, forestry, animal husbandry, and fishery.
For the purposes of these Regulations, 'insurance institution' refers to an insurance company and legally established insurance organizations such as agricultural mutual insurance.

Article 3 The State supports the development of various forms of agricultural insurance and improves the policy-based agricultural insurance system.
Agricultural insurance shall follow the principles of government guidance, market operation, voluntary participation, and coordinated promotion.
The people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government may determine the operational models of agricultural insurance suitable for the actual conditions of their respective regions.
No unit or individual may, by taking advantage of administrative power, position, professional convenience, or other means, compel or restrict farmers or agricultural production and operation organizations to participate in agricultural insurance.

Article 4 The insurance regulatory authority of the State Council shall exercise supervision and administration over agricultural insurance business. The relevant departments of the State Council such as finance, agriculture, forestry, development and reform, taxation, and civil affairs shall, in accordance with their respective functions and duties, be responsible for the promotion and management of agricultural insurance.
The relevant departments and institutions such as finance, insurance supervision and administration, land and resources, agriculture, forestry, and meteorology shall establish a sharing mechanism for information related to agricultural insurance.

Article 5 The local people's governments at or above the county level shall uniformly lead, organize, and coordinate the agricultural insurance work within their respective administrative regions, and establish and improve a working mechanism to promote the development of agricultural insurance. The relevant departments of the local people's governments at or above the county level shall, in accordance with the functions and duties prescribed by the people's government at the same level, be responsible for the promotion and management of agricultural insurance within their respective administrative regions.

Article 6 The relevant departments and institutions of the State Council, and the local people's governments at all levels and their relevant departments shall adopt various forms to strengthen the publicity of agricultural insurance, enhance the insurance awareness of farmers and agricultural production and operation organizations, and organize and guide farmers and agricultural production and operation organizations to actively participate in agricultural insurance.

Article 7 Where the subject matter insured under the agricultural insurance taken out by farmers or agricultural production and operation organizations falls within the scope of premium subsidies granted by the finance department, the finance department shall grant premium subsidies in accordance with regulations. The specific measures shall be formulated by the finance department of the State Council in consultation with the competent department of agriculture, forestry of the State Council and the insurance regulatory authority.
The State encourages local people's governments to adopt measures such as granting premium subsidies from local finance to support the development of agricultural insurance.

Article 8 The State shall establish a fiscal-supported risk diversification mechanism for catastrophic events in agricultural insurance. The specific measures shall be formulated by the finance department of the State Council jointly with the relevant departments of the State Council.
The State encourages local people's governments to establish a local fiscal-supported risk diversification mechanism for catastrophic events in agricultural insurance.

Article 9 Insurance institutions operating agricultural insurance business shall enjoy tax preferences according to law.
The State supports insurance institutions in establishing a grass-roots service system that meets the needs of the development of agricultural insurance business.
The State encourages financial institutions to increase credit support for farmers and agricultural production and operation organizations that have taken out agricultural insurance.

Article 10 Agricultural insurance may be taken out directly by farmers or agricultural production and operation organizations, or may be taken out by farmers organized by units such as agricultural production and operation organizations or villagers committees.
Where farmers are organized to take out insurance by agricultural production and operation organizations, villagers committees or other units, the insurance institution shall, when concluding the agricultural insurance contract, prepare an insurance list specifying in detail the insurance information of the insured, and such list shall be signed and confirmed by the insured. The insurance institution shall publicize the underwriting situation.

Article 11 During the term of validity of an agricultural insurance contract, the parties to the contract may not increase the premium or terminate the agricultural insurance contract due to a change in the degree of risk of the subject matter insured.

Article 12 Upon receipt of a notice of an insurance accident, the insurance institution shall promptly conduct on-site survey and jointly verify with the insured the damage to the subject matter insured. Where insurance is taken out by farmers organized by agricultural production and operation organizations, villagers committees or other units, the insurance institution shall publicize the results of the survey and loss assessment.
The insurance institution, in accordance with the provisions of the agricultural insurance contract, may adopt sampling methods or other methods to verify the extent of loss of the subject matter insured. Where sampling methods are used to verify the extent of loss, the sampling technical specifications prescribed by relevant authorities shall be complied with.

Article 13 Where laws or administrative regulations provide for the disposal of damaged subject matter insured in agricultural insurance, the insurance institution shall, when settling claims, obtain evidence or documentary materials that the damaged subject matter insured has been disposed of according to law.
An insurance institution may not assert any right to the residual value of the damaged subject matter insured, unless otherwise agreed in the agricultural insurance contract.

Article 14 The insurance institution shall, within 10 days after reaching an agreement on compensation with the insured, pay the insurance compensation payable to the insured. Where the agricultural insurance contract has an agreed period for paying insurance compensation, the insurance institution shall perform the obligation to pay insurance compensation in accordance with such agreement.

Article 15 The insurance institution shall, in accordance with the provisions of the agricultural insurance contract, pay the full amount of insurance compensation payable based on the verified extent of loss of the subject matter insured.
No unit or individual may illegally interfere with the insurance institution's performance of its obligation to pay insurance compensation, or restrict the insured's right to obtain insurance compensation.
Where agricultural production and operation organizations, villagers committees or other units organize farmers to take out insurance, the claims settlement list shall be signed and confirmed by the insured, and the insurance institution shall publicize the claims settlement results.

Article 16 For matters not provided for in these Regulations regarding agricultural insurance contracts, reference shall be made to the relevant provisions on insurance contracts in the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 18 An insurance institution operating agricultural insurance business shall practice independent operation and assume sole responsibility for its profits and losses.
An insurance institution operating agricultural insurance business shall manage it separately from other insurance businesses, and independently calculate profits and losses.

Article 19 An insurance institution shall fairly and reasonably formulate agricultural insurance clauses and premium rates. For the insurance clauses and premium rates of insurance types for which the finance department grants premium subsidies, the insurance institution shall formulate them on the basis of fully soliciting opinions from the finance, agriculture, and forestry departments of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, as well as from farmer representatives.
The agricultural insurance clauses and premium rates shall be submitted to the insurance regulatory authority for approval or for record according to law.

Article 20 The assessment of reserves and the preparation of solvency reports for agricultural insurance business operated by an insurance institution shall comply with the provisions of the insurance regulatory authority of the State Council.
Where special principles and methods are required for the financial management and accounting of agricultural insurance business, the finance department of the State Council shall formulate specific measures.

Article 21 An insurance institution may entrust grass-roots agricultural technology extension institutions or other institutions to assist in handling agricultural insurance business. The insurance institution shall sign a written contract with the entrusted institution assisting in handling agricultural insurance business, specifying the rights and obligations of both parties, stipulating the payment of fees, and providing business guidance to the institution assisting in handling agricultural insurance business.

Article 22 An insurance institution shall properly preserve the original documents of survey and loss assessment for agricultural insurance in accordance with the provisions of the insurance regulatory authority of the State Council.
No unit or individual may alter, falsify, conceal, or destroy, in violation of regulations, the original documents of survey and loss assessment.

Article 23 The obtaining and use of premium subsidies shall comply with the provisions of the specific measures formulated in accordance with Article 7 of these Regulations.
It is prohibited to fraudulently obtain agricultural insurance premium subsidies by the following methods or any other methods:
(1) fabricating or inflating the subject matter insured, or taking out insurance multiple times on the same subject matter insured;
(2) offsetting the premiums payable by the applicant or the premium subsidies granted by the finance department by means such as fraudulent claims, false expenses, fraudulent policy surrender, or interception, misappropriation of insurance compensation, or misappropriation of operating expenses.
Article 24 No unit or individual may misappropriate, intercept, or embezzle the insurance compensation that an insurance institution shall pay to the insured.

Article 25 For matters not provided for in these Regulations regarding the operational rules for agricultural insurance, the relevant provisions on insurance operational rules and supervision and administration in the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China shall apply.

Article 26 Where an insurance institution operates agricultural insurance business without meeting the conditions set forth in Article 17(1) of these Regulations, the insurance regulatory authority shall order it to make corrections within a time limit and stop accepting new business; if it fails to make corrections within the time limit or causes serious consequences, it shall be fined not less than RMB 100,000 yuan but not more than RMB 500,000 yuan, and may be ordered to suspend business for rectification or have its insurance business permit revoked.
Where any other organization or individual other than an insurance institution illegally operates agricultural insurance business, the insurance regulatory authority shall ban it, confiscate its illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains or the illegal gains are less than RMB 200,000 yuan, a fine of not less than RMB 200,000 yuan but not more than RMB 1,000,000 yuan shall be imposed.

Article 29 Where an insurance institution violates these Regulations, in addition to imposing penalties in accordance with these Regulations, the insurance regulatory authority shall give a warning to the directly responsible supervisor and other directly responsible persons, and impose a fine of not less than RMB 10,000 yuan but not more than RMB 100,000 yuan; if the circumstances are serious, the relevant qualifications shall be revoked for those who have obtained qualification for holding positions or practicing.

Article 30 Where anyone, in violation of Article 23 of these Regulations, fraudulently obtains premium subsidies, the finance department shall handle the matter in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Regulations on Penalties and Sanctions for Fiscal Violations; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Where anyone, in violation of Article 24 of these Regulations, misappropriates, intercepts, or embezzles insurance compensation, the relevant authorities shall handle the matter according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 31 Where legal liability for an insurance institution's violation of these Regulations is not provided for in these Regulations, the relevant provisions of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China shall apply.

Article 32 An insurance institution operating policy-supported agriculture-related insurance shall reference the relevant provisions of these Regulations.
Agriculture-related insurance refers to insurance that provides insurance protection for farmers in agricultural production and daily life, excluding agricultural insurance, including property insurance such as rural housing, agricultural machinery, and fishing vessels, as well as short-term accident insurance covering the life and body of farmers.
Article 33 These Regulations shall come into force as of March 1, 2013.
